emotional_tone: Magical, wonder, joy, adventure, premium, ancient, tactile

font_rules.h1: font-['Pirata_One'] text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-wider text-loxedex-ink drop-shadow-sm

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden relative

HomeDesk.wrapper_classes: relative w-full h-screen bg-void flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden
HomeDesk.background_layer: absolute inset-0 bg-cover bg-center opacity-60 mix-blend-multiply transition-all duration-1000
HomeDesk.instruction: This is the main cinematic entry. Replace pure pitch-black with a deep dark textured void using the vignette. Dynamic local time should shift the opacity/hue of the ambient glow.

LoxedexBook.wrapper_classes: relative bg-[#F4EFE6] w-full max-w-5xl aspect-[4/3] rounded-sm shadow-[20px_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8),inset_0_0_60px_rgba(140,115,86,0.3)] flex overflow-hidden z-20 transition-transform duration-700 hover:scale-[1.01]
LoxedexBook.spine: absolute left-1/2 top-0 bottom-0 w-8 -ml-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#8C7356]/40 to-transparent z-30 shadow-[inset_1px_0_5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)]
LoxedexBook.instruction: Simulate a heavy unrolled map or open book. The spine gives the illusion of two pages. Use jagged/deckled borders with CSS clip-path or complex border graphics if available, or just heavy inner shadow.

AnimalCard.wrapper_classes: relative bg-[#2A1F18] border-2 border-[#16100B] rounded-md shadow-[0_15px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)] p-4 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(255,215,0,0.2)]
AnimalCard.image_container: w-full aspect-square bg-[#1A120B] rounded-sm overflow-hidden relative border border-[#3A2A1F]
AnimalCard.stats_row: flex justify-between items-center mt-4 border-t border-[#3A2A1F] pt-2
AnimalCard.instruction: This represents the 3D wooden tile. Image should look burned in (pyrography) unless it's a 5-star which bursts into vibrant color with golden glowing chi veins.

WorldMap.biome_node: cursor-pointer transition-all duration-500 fill-current opacity-70 hover:opacity-100 hover:scale-105 origin-center
WorldMap.instruction: SVG-based map. Each biome is a path. When hovered, the path glows intensely with its specific biome color.

SaolaGuide.wrapper_classes: fixed bottom-4 right-4 md:bottom-8 md:right-8 w-32 h-40 z-50 animate-[bounce_4s_ease-in-out_infinite]
SaolaGuide.dialog_bubble: absolute bottom-full right-full mb-4 mr-2 bg-[#F4EFE6] text-loxedex-ink p-4 rounded-tl-xl rounded-tr-xl rounded-bl-xl shadow-xl font-['Space_Mono'] text-sm max-w-xs border-2 border-[#8C7356]
SaolaGuide.lantern_glow: absolute bottom-4 right-4 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-chi-gold opacity-50 blur-xl animate-pulse
SaolaGuide.instruction: Humorous guide character. Will pop up text in the dialog bubble. When a 5-star is found, the lantern glow expands and turns intensely bright.

RaritySystem.unlocked: grayscale-0 opacity-100 blur-0 brightness-100 transition-all duration-1000
RaritySystem.instruction: 1-2 stars show clearly but muted. 3-5 stars show as faint charcoal sketches until unlocked. The unlock triggers a violent shake and a burst of color.

interactive_elements.primary_button: bg-gradient-to-r from-chi-gold to-chi-gold_glow text-void font-['Bebas_Neue'] text-2xl px-8 py-3 rounded-sm shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,215,0,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(255,215,0,0.8)] hover:scale-105 transition-all duration-300
interactive_elements.secondary_button: bg-[#2A1F18] text-[#F4EFE6] border border-[#8C7356] font-['Space_Mono'] text-sm px-6 py-2 hover:bg-[#3A2A1F] transition-colors duration-200
interactive_elements.test_id_rule: ALL interactive elements must include a role-based data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='map-biome-savanna', data-testid='loxedex-next-page').

placeholders.saola: Render using SVG or a stylized CSS shape for now, wrapping with floating animations.
placeholders.animals: Use Unsplash queries for specific animals applying the pyrography CSS filter if 3D assets aren't available.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts provided in the font_stack exactly.
Do NOT use pure #000000 background for the body. Use the 'void' or 'desk' color defined here, layered with the night_glow texture on low opacity/multiply blend mode for a deep, cinematic feel.
Implement the 'Loxedex' as an actual book-like interface on desktop using the parchment colors and texture overlay.
Ensure the Saola character has a glowing lantern element that pulses using Tailwind animations.
When rendering 1-2 star animals, show them normally. When rendering 3-5 star locked animals, heavily apply grayscale, blur, and opacity to simulate a 'charcoal sketch'.
Make sure every interactive click target has a specific 'data-testid' based on its role.
For the dynamic local-time lighting: Use a simple JS check of new Date().getHours() to apply a warm orange overlay layer (opacity 10-20%) during day, and a cool blue overlay layer during night.
